# Figure 3 sensitivity analysis: squared deviation of of dominant vs. non-dominant pathways in comparing their pathway enrichment values in aggregated signatures and median individual signatures 

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(dplyr)
library(gt)
```

```{r all-thresholds-plot, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
thresholds <- c(0.95,0.90,0.85,0.80,0.75,0.70,0.65,0.60,0)
summary_df <- read_tsv(
  here("figures/figure2/metadata_annotation/annotation_table.tsv"),show_col_types = FALSE)

up_pathway_df <- read_tsv(here("figures/figureS4/figureS4a/marray_rnaseq_asinh_up_pathways_sensitivity.tsv"),show_col_types = FALSE)
dn_pathway_df <- read_tsv(here("figures/figureS4/figureS4b/marray_rnaseq_asinh_dn_pathways_sensitivity.tsv"),show_col_types = FALSE)

get_available_thresholds <- function(pathway_df, direction_name) {
  tibble(
    aggregate_col = colnames(pathway_df)
  ) %>%
    filter(
      str_detect(
        aggregate_col,
        "^aggregated_(microarray|RNAseq)(_(0|0-[0-9]+))?$"
      )
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      technology = case_when(
        str_detect(aggregate_col, "^aggregated_microarray") ~ "Microarray",
        str_detect(aggregate_col, "^aggregated_RNAseq") ~ "RNAseq"
      ),
      threshold_value = case_when(
        # Unsuffixed or "_0" columns represent threshold zero
        str_detect(
          aggregate_col,
          "^aggregated_(microarray|RNAseq)(_0)?$"
        ) ~ 0,
        TRUE ~ aggregate_col %>%
          str_extract("0-[0-9]+$") %>%
          str_replace("-", ".") %>%
          as.numeric() %>%
          round(2)
      ),
      direction = direction_name
    )
}

available_thresholds <- bind_rows(
  get_available_thresholds(
    up_pathway_df,
    "Upregulated"
  ),
  get_available_thresholds(
    dn_pathway_df,
    "Downregulated"
  )
) %>%
  filter(
    threshold_value %in% thresholds
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    direction,
    technology,
    match(threshold_value, thresholds)
  )

print(available_thresholds)

expected_combinations <- crossing(
  direction = c(
    "Upregulated",
    "Downregulated"
  ),
  technology = c(
    "Microarray",
    "RNAseq"
  ),
  threshold_value = thresholds
)

missing_combinations <- expected_combinations %>%
  anti_join(
    available_thresholds %>%
      dplyr::select(
        direction,
        technology,
        threshold_value
      ),
    by = c(
      "direction",
      "technology",
      "threshold_value"
    )
  )


calculate_threshold_deviation <- function(
    pathway_df,
    direction_name,
    technology_name,
    threshold,
    aggregate_col
) {
  
  technology_key <- if_else(
    technology_name == "Microarray",
    "microarray",
    "RNAseq"
  )
  
  aggregate_signature_id <- if_else(
    technology_name == "Microarray",
    "aggregated_microarray",
    "aggregated_RNAseq"
  )
  
  individual_cols <- intersect(
    colnames(pathway_df),
    summary_df$signature_name[
      summary_df$technology == technology_key &
        summary_df$signature_ID != aggregate_signature_id
    ]
  )
  
  if (length(individual_cols) == 0) {
    stop(
      "No individual signatures found for ",
      technology_name
    )
  }
  
  if (!aggregate_col %in% colnames(pathway_df)) {
    stop(
      "Aggregate column not found: ",
      aggregate_col
    )
  }
  
  individual_mat <- as.matrix(
    pathway_df[, individual_cols, drop = FALSE]
  )
  
  storage.mode(individual_mat) <- "numeric"
  
  aggregated <- as.numeric(
    pathway_df[[aggregate_col]]
  )
  
  median_individual <- apply(
    individual_mat,
    1,
    function(x) median(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
  
  proportion_enriched <- rowMeans(
    individual_mat != 0,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
  
  n_signatures <- ncol(individual_mat)
  
  tibble(
    pathway = pathway_df$Description,
    median_individual = median_individual,
    aggregated = aggregated,
    proportion_enriched = proportion_enriched,
    deviation_score =
      (aggregated - median_individual)^2 /
      n_signatures,
    technology = technology_name,
    direction = direction_name,
    threshold_value = threshold,
    aggregate_col = aggregate_col, 
    enrichment = if_else(
      proportion_enriched >= 0.9, # pathways enriched in at least 90% of signatures
      "Dominant\nGO:BP terms",
      "Non-dominant\nGO:BP terms"
    )
  )
}

sq_dev_all_thresholds <- available_thresholds %>%
  pmap_dfr(
    function(
        aggregate_col,
        technology,
        threshold_value,
        direction
    ) {
      
      pathway_df <- if (
        direction == "Upregulated"
      ) {
        up_pathway_df
      } else {
        dn_pathway_df
      }
      
      calculate_threshold_deviation(
        pathway_df = pathway_df,
        direction_name = direction,
        technology_name = technology,
        threshold = threshold_value,
        aggregate_col = aggregate_col
      )
    }
  ) %>%
  
  filter(
    !is.na(aggregated),
    !is.na(median_individual),
    !(
      aggregated == 0 &
        median_individual == 0
    )
  )

threshold_levels <- paste0(
  thresholds * 100,
  "%"
)

sq_dev_all_thresholds <- sq_dev_all_thresholds %>%
  mutate(
    threshold = paste0(
      threshold_value * 100,
      "%"
    ),
    threshold = factor(
      threshold,
      levels = threshold_levels
    ),
    direction = factor(
      direction,
      levels = c(
        "Upregulated",
        "Downregulated"
      )
    ),
    technology = factor(
      technology,
      levels = c(
        "Microarray",
        "RNAseq"
      )
    ),
    enrichment = factor(
      enrichment,
      levels = c(
        "Dominant\nGO:BP terms",
        "Non-dominant\nGO:BP terms"
      )
    )
  )

plot_counts <- sq_dev_all_thresholds %>%
  count(
    direction,
    technology,
    threshold,
    enrichment,
    name = "n"
  )

print(plot_counts)
```
```{r stats table}
dominant_label <- "Dominant\nGO:BP terms"
nondominant_label <- "Non-dominant\nGO:BP terms"

stats_results <- sq_dev_all_thresholds %>%
  filter(
    is.finite(deviation_score),
    !is.na(enrichment)
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    direction,
    technology,
    threshold
  ) %>%
  group_modify(
    ~ {
      dominant_values <- .x %>%
        filter(enrichment == dominant_label) %>%
        pull(deviation_score)

      nondominant_values <- .x %>%
        filter(enrichment == nondominant_label) %>%
        pull(deviation_score)

      if (
        length(dominant_values) > 0 &&
        length(nondominant_values) > 0
      ) {
        test_result <- wilcox.test(
          x = nondominant_values,
          y = dominant_values,
          alternative = "greater",
          exact = FALSE
        )

        tibble(
          n_dominant = length(dominant_values),
          n_nondominant = length(nondominant_values),
          median_dominant = median(
            dominant_values,
            na.rm = TRUE
          ),
          median_nondominant = median(
            nondominant_values,
            na.rm = TRUE
          ),
          statistic_W = unname(
            test_result$statistic
          ),
          p_value = test_result$p.value
        )
      } else {
        tibble(
          n_dominant = length(dominant_values),
          n_nondominant = length(nondominant_values),
          median_dominant = if (
            length(dominant_values) > 0
          ) {
            median(
              dominant_values,
              na.rm = TRUE
            )
          } else {
            NA_real_
          },
          median_nondominant = if (
            length(nondominant_values) > 0
          ) {
            median(
              nondominant_values,
              na.rm = TRUE
            )
          } else {
            NA_real_
          },
          statistic_W = NA_real_,
          p_value = NA_real_
        )
      }
    }
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    p_adjusted_BH = p.adjust(
      p_value,
      method = "BH"
    ),
    significance = case_when(
      is.na(p_adjusted_BH) ~ "Not tested",
      p_adjusted_BH < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p_adjusted_BH < 0.01 ~ "**",
      p_adjusted_BH < 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ "ns"
    )
  )

print(stats_results)
```

```{r gt table}
stats_gt <- stats_results %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Direction = direction,
    Technology = technology,
    Threshold = threshold,
    `N dominant` = n_dominant,
    `N non-dominant` = n_nondominant,
    `Median dominant` = median_dominant,
    `Median non-dominant` = median_nondominant,
    `Mann-Whitney U` = statistic_W,
    `One-sided p-value` = p_value,
    `BH-adjusted p-value` = p_adjusted_BH,
    Significance = significance
  ) %>%
  gt(
    groupname_col = "Direction"
  ) %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md(
      "**One-sided Mann–Whitney test results**"
    ),
    subtitle = md(
      "Alternative hypothesis: non-dominant squared deviation > dominant squared deviation"
    )
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns = c(
      `Median dominant`,
      `Median non-dominant`
    ),
    decimals = 4
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns = `Mann-Whitney U`,
    decimals = 0,
    use_seps = TRUE
  ) %>%
  fmt_scientific(
    columns = c(
      `One-sided p-value`,
      `BH-adjusted p-value`
    ),
    decimals = 2
  ) %>%
  cols_align(
    align = "center",
    columns = everything()
  ) %>%
  tab_source_note(
    source_note = md(
      "P-values are from one-sided Wilcoxon rank-sum tests. BH adjustment accounts for testing across all per-threshold technology-gene-group pairs."
    )
  )
gtsave(data = stats_gt,filename = here("figures/figure3/Figure3_MW_stats_sensitivity_results.html"))

stats_gt
```

```{r upregulated | plot distribution of deviation across all thresholds with stats}
threshold_levels <- c("0%", "60%", "65%","70%", "75%", "80%","85%", "90%", "95%")
technology_levels <- unique(sq_dev_all_thresholds$technology)
sq_dev_all_thresholds_plot <- sq_dev_all_thresholds %>%
  filter(direction == "Upregulated") %>%
  mutate(threshold = factor(as.character(threshold),levels = threshold_levels),
    technology = factor(technology,levels = technology_levels)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(threshold))

stats_results_plot <- stats_results %>%
  filter(direction == "Upregulated") %>%
  mutate(threshold = factor(as.character(threshold),levels = threshold_levels),
    technology = factor(technology,levels = technology_levels)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(threshold))

pdf(here("figures/figure3/Figure3_squared_deviation_all_thresholds_up.pdf"),width = 12,height = 18)

ggplot(sq_dev_all_thresholds_plot,
  aes(
    x = enrichment,
    y = deviation_score,
    fill = enrichment
  )
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    alpha = 0.8,
    outlier.size = 0.5,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +

  geom_text(
    data = stats_results_plot,
    aes(
      x = 1.5,
      y = Inf,
      label = significance
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    vjust = 1.5,
    size = 6,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +

  scale_y_log10(
    breaks = 10^seq(-10,0,by = 2),
    labels = seq(-10,0,by = 2),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05,0.20))) +
  # 9 thresholds = 3 x 3 block per technology
  facet_wrap(
    vars(
      technology,
      threshold
    ),
    ncol = 3,
    scales = "free_y"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Enrichment",
    y = expression(
      log[10] * " squared deviation"
    ),
    caption = paste0(
      "One-sided Mann–Whitney test: ",
      "non-dominant > dominant. \n",
      "BH-adjusted P values: ",
      "*** P < 0.001; ** P < 0.01; ",
      "* P < 0.05; ns P ≥ 0.05."
    )
  ) +
  theme_bw(
    base_size = 11
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 18,margin = margin(t = 15)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12,face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95",color = NA),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size=15,angle = 0,hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size=15,angle = 0,hjust = 0.5),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 15,hjust = 0, vjust=0,margin = margin(t = 8)))

dev.off()
```

```{r up- and downregulated | plot stability across thresholds}
stability_plot <- sq_dev_all_thresholds %>%
  mutate(threshold_num = threshold_value * 100) %>%
  group_by(technology,direction,threshold_num,enrichment) %>%
  summarise(
    median_dev = median(deviation_score,na.rm = TRUE),
    q25 = quantile(deviation_score,0.25,na.rm = TRUE),
    q75 = quantile(deviation_score,0.75,na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

pdf(here("figures/figure3/Figure3_squared_deviation_stability_up_dn.pdf"),width = 14,height = 10)

ggplot(
  stability_plot,
  aes(
    x = threshold_num,
    y = median_dev,
    color = enrichment,
    group = enrichment
  )
) +
  # IQR
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = q25,ymax = q75,fill = enrichment),
    alpha = 0.15,
    color = NA
  ) +
  # median trend
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_y_log10(
    breaks = 10^seq(-10,0,by = 2),
    labels = seq(-10,0,by = 2)) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(
      0, 60, 65,
      70, 75, 80,
      85, 90, 95
    ),
    labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%")
  ) +
  facet_grid(
    rows = vars(direction),
    cols = vars(technology),
    scales = "free_y"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Threshold",
    y = expression(log[10] * " squared deviation"),
    color = "Enrichment",
    fill = "Enrichment"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95",color = NA),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 18,margin = margin(t = 15)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18,margin = margin(r = 12)),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 18,angle = 45,hjust = 1,vjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 18),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 18,face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 15),
    legend.position = "bottom"
)
dev.off()
```
